The state of West Bengal covers an
area of about 88,752 sq km bounded
by latitude 20031’ and 27014’N and
longitude 85051’ and 89053’E consisting
of 20 districts and 341 blocks. The
entire area falls under three major river
basins – (i) Brahmaputra Basin – part of
Darjiling, Jalpaiguri and Koch Bihar
districts, (ii) Ganga Basin – part of
Darjiling, Jalpaiguri and all the remaining
districts, and (iii) Subarnarekha basin –
parts of Puruliya, Purba and Paschim
Medinipur. The average rainfall in the
